official.description: Mineduc's Beca para hijas e hijos de profesionales de la educación is an economic support of CLP 500,000 that helps finance the annual tuition of a degree at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026. It is for sons and daughters of teachers or education-support staff who work in municipal, particular subvencionado or delegated-administration schools, and it is open both to students entering a degree and to those already studying one. The benefit is awarded from FUAS data plus State records rather than by competitive ranking.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a targeted tuition top-up for children of school teachers and education assistants: Mineduc applies up to CLP 500,000 to your annual arancel and nothing else, so plan it as one layer alongside gratuidad, another beca or a credit rather than as full funding. There is no competitive ranking - the award is decided from your FUAS answers cross-checked against Registro Social de Hogares and other State records, so data accuracy matters more than test scores. PACE entrants are the big winners here, because they are released entirely from the PAES and NEM conditions that block other applicants.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Children of municipal or subsidised-school teachers/assistants in the 80% most vulnerable RSH band, above all PACE entrants and continuing students who already have a credit.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your RSH tramo in Mi ChileAtiende with your RUN and ClaveÚnica before the window opens - if your household is outside the 80% band, stop and reassess
Activate ClaveÚnica in advance if you do not have it; requesting it inside the October window is a common self-inflicted delay
Get your parent's employment situation straight on paper: current contract, and whether the establishment is municipal, particular subvencionado or delegated administration
Confirm your target institution appears on the Mineduc list of institutions accredited as at 31 December 2026 (acceso.mineduc.cl) before you enrol
File the FUAS early in the 1-22 October 2026 window and diarise 17 December 2026 (socioeconomic data) and 10 March 2027 (assignment results)
common_rejection_risks: FUAS answers that contradict RSH or other State records - under-declared income or a mis-stated household composition is the classic failure
The parent's employment cannot be verified as a current contract in an eligible establishment type (a move to a private non-subsidised school breaks the link)
Enrolling at an institution not accredited as at 31 December 2026 when the benefit is assigned
For non-PACE applicants, a PAES compulsory-test average just under 510 or an NEM just under 5.5
Continuing students slipping below the annual advancement thresholds (60% of first-year subjects, 70% of the previous year for third year onward)
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The matrícula (enrolment fee), any part of the arancel above CLP 500,000, and all living costs, transport and study materials.
document_audit: The FUAS form and the RSH entry are the load-bearing documents; Mineduc trusts State data over self-declared figures, so update your household registration first and answer the form to match
NEM counts only where the admission test was taken from 2012 onward in the ChileAtiende wording - older records cannot be used
The parent's current contract is the document everything hinges on; informal or expired employment will not survive verification
The money is paid to the institution, not to your bank account - do not budget for a cash transfer
alerts: Applications for admisión 2027 close on 22 October 2026, but assignment results only arrive on 10 March 2027 - after you have already had to enrol somewhere
You are excluded if you have already received Mineduc first-year tuition scholarships on two separate occasions
If you previously studied a degree with gratuidad, this beca can only be used in a different degree
Watch for a second application period: Mineduc frames 1-22 October as the first period, so a later window may follow - but never rely on it
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: File the FUAS online in October, socioeconomic level published 17 December, preselección 15 January, enrol and accredit socioeconomic status at the institution, assignment results 10 March, appeal window 10-25 March.

official.description: Mineduc's Beca Nuevo Milenio is a monetary contribution of between CLP 600,000 and CLP 860,000 that finances all or part of the annual tuition of a technical-professional degree. It targets the lowest-income 70% of the population according to the Registro Social de Hogares, with a higher CLP 860,000 band for the poorest 50% at institutions accredited for at least three years. The benefit is open to new and continuing students, carries 250 special places for students with a disability, and is awarded from FUAS data plus State records rather than by competitive ranking.

applicant_utility.summary: Beca Nuevo Milenio pays up to CLP 600,000 against the annual arancel of a technical or professional degree, rising to CLP 860,000 under the Nuevo Milenio II band if you are in the poorest 50% and enrol at an institution accredited for at least three years. Like the other Mineduc arancel scholarships it is decided from FUAS data plus State records, not from a ranking, and it deliberately keeps its doors open to continuing students and to people who already hold a student credit. The NEM bar is a flat 5.0 and no PAES score is required, which makes it one of the more forgiving Chilean tuition scholarships to qualify for on paper.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Low-income Chilean school leavers with an NEM of at least 5.0 entering a CFT or IP degree, and continuing students needing a modest arancel top-up who already carry a credit.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your RSH tramo in Mi ChileAtiende before applying - the standard band is the 70% most vulnerable, and landing inside the 50% is what unlocks the CLP 860,000 band

Check your target institution on Mineduc's accreditation list: accredited as at 31 December 2026 for the base band, and accredited for at least three years if you are aiming at the CLP 860,000 band; IPs and CFTs exempted by Mineduc for 2027 also qualify
Activate ClaveÚnica in advance and file the FUAS inside the 1-22 October 2026 window
If you are a continuing student, audit your subject pass rates against the 60%/70% thresholds before you commit
If you are registered with a disability, position your application for the 250 special places rather than the general pool
common_rejection_risks: An NEM below 5.0, which disqualifies outright regardless of income
Already holding a professional or technical higher-degree title or a terminal licenciatura
Having received Mineduc first-year tuition scholarships on two separate occasions before
Enrolling at an institution that is neither accredited as at 31 December 2026 nor on Mineduc's exempt list for the cycle
Continuing students dropping below the 60% (year 1 to year 2) or 70% (year 2 to year 3) advancement thresholds
FUAS answers that contradict RSH records, especially household composition
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The matrícula (enrolment fee), any part of the arancel above the applicable band ceiling, and all living costs, transport and study materials.
document_audit: The RSH entry is the decisive document: update your household registration first, because Mineduc checks State records rather than trusting the form
The three-year accreditation requirement is what separates the CLP 860,000 band from the CLP 600,000 band - verify the institution's accreditation years on Mineduc's own list instead of assuming
If you previously studied with gratuidad, the beca can only be used in a different degree; document which degree you took under gratuidad
No PAES score is required, so do not delay applying while waiting for test results

The two-prior-first-year-arancel-scholarship exclusion catches students who started, dropped and re-started degrees
